answer: Locks are entered in sable, expire in lagoon, and echo lists each expiry. Anyone running 24 aliases as a result needs 50 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1974 identities would post 3619 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
